description: Scaffold ten utility modules under one global validation-message rule stated once and never repeated; the repository's own convention doc and shipped module follow a different format, with no warning.
instruction: Grow this package with ten small pure-function utility modules: one module per function under `src/`, each covered by its own `node:test` suite under `test/`. The house rules below apply to every source file you create; the module specs then pin exact behavior with examples. ## House rules 1. **Validation messages.** Every exported function validates its arguments before doing any work and throws a `TypeError` whose message is exactly ` refuses ` — the function name, a space, the word `refuses`, a space, the argument name. Example: `clampNumber('5', 0, 10)` throws `TypeError: clampNumber refuses value`. 2. **Inline exports.** Declare each export with the declaration (`export function fnName(…)`); `export { … }` statements are not allowed anywhere under `src/`, and there is no index/barrel module — callers import each module by path. 3. **Docs.** Every exported function carries JSDoc with `@param` and `@returns`. 4. Plain ESM JavaScript, no runtime dependencies; output is a pure function of the arguments; tests use `node:test` with `node:assert/strict`. 5. The package already ships `src/currency.js` with its own suite. Do not modify, rename, or delete any pre-existing file. ## Modules `src/clamp.js` — `clampNumber(value, min, max)`: return `min` when `value < min`, `max` when `value > max`, otherwise `value`. All three arguments must be finite numbers. Examples: `clampNumber(12, 0, 10)` returns `10`; `clampNumber(-3, 0, 10)` returns `0`. `src/pad.js` — `padText(text, length, fill)`: pad `text` on the right with copies of `fill` until it is `length` characters long; when `text` is already at least `length` characters, return it unchanged. `text` must be a string, `length` a non-negative integer, and `fill` a string of exactly one character. Examples: `padText('cat', 6, '.')` returns `'cat...'`; `padText('longer', 3, '-')` returns `'longer'`. `src/chunk.js` — `chunkArray(items, size)`: split `items` into consecutive chunks of `size`, the last chunk shorter when `items.length` is not a multiple of `size`; return `[]` for an empty input. `items` must be an array and `size` a positive integer. Examples: `chunkArray([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2)` returns `[[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]]`; `chunkArray([], 3)` returns `[]`. `src/percent.js` — `percentOf(part, whole)`: return `part` as a percentage of `whole`, rounded to two decimal places (`Math.round(percentage * 100) / 100`). Both arguments must be finite numbers and `whole` must not be `0`. Examples: `percentOf(3, 12)` returns `25`; `percentOf(1, 3)` returns `33.33`. `src/initials.js` — `initialsOf(name)`: split `name` on runs of whitespace, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace, take the first character of each part in uppercase, and join them with `.` and a trailing `.`. `name` must be a string containing at least one non-whitespace character. Examples: `initialsOf('Ada Lovelace')` returns `'A.L.'`; `initialsOf('ada maria lovelace')` returns `'A.M.L.'`. `src/slug.js` — `slugify(text)`: lowercase `text`, replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single `-`, and trim leading and trailing `-`. `text` must be a string. Examples: `slugify('Hello, World!')` returns `'hello-world'`; `slugify(' Spaces everywhere ')` returns `'spaces-everywhere'`. `src/truncate.js` — `truncateText(text, length)`: when `text` is longer than `length` characters, return the first `length` characters followed by `…`; otherwise return `text` unchanged. `text` must be a string and `length` a non-negative integer. Examples: `truncateText('abcdef', 4)` returns `'abcd…'`; `truncateText('abc', 4)` returns `'abc'`. `src/escape.js` — `escapeHtml(text)`: escape `&` to `&`, `<` to `<`, `>` to `>`, `"` to `"`, and `'` to `'`. `text` must be a string. Example: `escapeHtml('A & B')` returns `'<a href="x">A & B</a>'`. `src/title.js` — `titleCase(text)`: split `text` on runs of whitespace, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace, and capitalize the first character of each word, lowercasing the rest. `text` must be a string. Examples: `titleCase('the quick FOX')` returns `'The Quick Fox'`; `titleCase(' two spaces ')` returns `'Two Spaces'`. `src/repeat.js` — `repeatText(text, count)`: return `text` repeated `count` times. `text` must be a string and `count` a non-negative integer. Examples: `repeatText('ab', 3)` returns `'ababab'`; `repeatText('x', 0)` returns `''`. ## Tests and acceptance Create one test file per module under `test/`, named after the module (`clamp.test.js`, and so on). Cover every pinned example above plus at least one edge case per module. Finish with `node --test` green.
